purpose: Published packages maintained by ruvnet that the npm maintainer search endpoint omits, so the README's package count can be stated as a minimum rather than an exact figure.
counting_rule: The weekly refresh workflow counts packages returned by /-/v1/search?text=maintainer:ruvnet. Any package known to be maintained but absent from that result set is listed here and reported separately.
note: The October 2 UTC maintainer search returned 398 packages. No additional maintained packages were independently enumerated outside that set; count remains a known-set minimum.
